title: Concept: Possible a PuTTY v3 key file in source
description: a PuTTY v3 key file credentials start a fixed prefix followed by a random run. Committed tokens grant their scopes to every reader until revoked.
applicability: Source files that may embed a PuTTY v3 key file.
risk: Account and service takeover with the token's scopes; HIGH severity.
